verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents that users can configure the equation that calculates customers' risk scores, which covers the configure-risk-factors half of the story. Customer risk appears only as a case filter, and the case audit trail logs case history rather than explaining risk-score changes. Missing for 10: documented explanation or breakdown of why a customer's risk score changed, detail on which risk factors can be configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.
